title: add vpc control plane terraform: multi-az subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, peering, route53
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds a new Terraform module and examples to provision a multi-AZ VPC control plane for Private deployments. Includes interface endpoints, security groups, cross-account VPC peering helpers, and Route53 private hosted zone setup. Backwards compatible default variables; opt-in for cross-account peering and advanced DNS forwarding.
description: Context: Private deployments require a repeatable, secure VPC topology for the control plane. This PR introduces a first-class Terraform module (terraform/modules/vpc-control-plane) to provision a multi-AZ VPC with subnet layout, interface endpoints, hardened security groups, optional cross-account peering and Route53 private zone integration. Motivation: replace one-off customer scripts with a supported, testable module and provide a canonical example for the private installer and partner automation. What this PR does: - New module: terraform/modules/vpc-control-plane that creates public/private subnets across configurable AZs, NAT gateways (optional), and subnet tagging used by the installer. - Interface endpoints: AWS Interface endpoints for S3, ECR API/DOCKER, STS, KMS (configurable) so control plane can operate without internet egress. - Security groups: least-privilege SGs for control-plane instances, inter-node, and management access; explicit egress/ingress rules and helpers to map customer management CIDRs. - Peering: cross-account VPC peering helper resources and documentation for route propagation and dedicated peering SG rules. The peering is opt-in and guarded by variable flags. - DNS: Route53 private hosted zone created/linked to the control-plane VPC; optional conditional-forwarding configuration for partner account integration. - Examples: an examples/private/vpc folder with a full example and README documenting step-by-step provisioning, IAM pre-reqs and Linear/Jira links. Compatibility/Upgrade notes: defaults preserve the current single-AZ behavior unless users opt into multi-az (variable multi_az = true). Existing installs that use the current quickstart are unaffected by default. Rolling upgrades: the module includes explicit resource lifecycle rules and documented upgrade steps in docs/private-deploy/vpc-control-plane.md. Rollback plan: sample terraform state checkpoints and recommended destroy/apply sequence are included in the example. Testing: - Unit: terraform validate and fmt in CI - Integration: e2e provisioner test in perf-canary pipeline that runs a smoke create/destroy in a sandbox AWS account (recorded). - Security review: SGs and endpoints reviewed by security and ops. Checklist: - [x] Module implementation - [x] Examples and README - [x] CI: fmt/validate/unit/integration - [x] Docs: migration/upgrade notes - [x] Security review and approval Related: ENG-8742 (recommended topology), SUP-4521 (customer request). Files touched: see files_changed list for details. Merge: squashed and merged after approvals.

notes: This PR consolidates VPC control plane provisioning into a reusable Terraform module used by the private installer and partner automation. The module is feature-flagged for advanced options to keep backwards compatibility. Ops and security have validated the topology in a sandbox account. Follow docs/private-deploy/vpc-control-plane.md for rollout and rollback steps.
